live.title: Alive
live.owner_words: The app should feel more live and smooth and the smoothness must be on the next level, it should load faster and without decreasing the quality, make the next update, improve more smoothness
live.note: Answered in three parts, each measured on this tree. SMOOTHER: the press vocabulary now covers what a thumb actually touches (it covered buttons only), and the press is a compositor scale with filter removed. LIVE: pending price breathes, live dot on the utility strip, first-row settle, bag badge pop, rate hairline — all event-bound; on a settled page one of them is running. FASTER WITHOUT LOSING QUALITY: the one stylesheet ships minified (-88,610 B raw, ~-16 KB gzip) with a build step that proves the minified sheet is the same sheet rule by rule before writing it; cms/css/shivaa.css stays in the repo and in the package, so a rollback is one <link>. Also: decoding=async on every image the app renders. Desktop keeps its blur and hover vocabulary — every new rule is scoped to html.shv-mobile.

rules.forward_only: A release number is spent once it is in this ledger. Never renumber, rebuild-to-change, re-ship or revert it. The highest release number is the only truth; any tree below it is history.
rules.deploy: Only the owner deploys, and only after his explicit yes. A push, a merge or a green gate is not approval.
rules.rollback: Rolling back means the PREVIOUS ledger row, never an older tree than live.
rules.guard: Run `bash qa/where-am-i.sh` first in every chat, on any branch. Exit 3 means this tree is behind: stop and move to the release branch it names.

releases.note: v250 took the phone's continuous animation away and, with it, every SIGN that the shop is live. v251 gives the sign back out of a budget a phone can spare — transform and opacity, answered by an event, never running on its own. PRESS: every card, tile, chip, tab, drawer row and icon button on a phone answers a tap in 90 ms with scale(.977) on the universal --sx-* rhythm; filter is explicitly removed from the press path (v107 repainted on every press). LIVE: a pending price breathes (opacity only, 1.4 s), the utility strip carries a 6 px live dot, the first row of the grid settles in 24 ms steps travelling 10 px (opacity never changes, so it cannot blink), the bag badge pops for 320 ms when its number changes (MutationObserver on #cartCount/#wishCount), and a fresh rate sweeps one gold hairline (the `rates` event). On a settled page exactly ONE of those is running. POSITION: a 2 px gold read bar, created by the script, filled with transform: scaleX() from one rAF per scroll frame; the page height is measured on resize/route, never inside the scroll handler. FASTER: index.html now loads the MINIFIED build of the one stylesheet — cms/css/shivaa.min.css, 965,451 B -> 876,841 B (-9.2 %; gzip ~191 KB -> 174,636 B) — and tools/build-css-min.mjs REFUSES to write it unless it is structurally identical to the readable bundle (8,758 effective rules compared with their media context, 9 @font-face, 264 @keyframes, csso with restructure:false so no rule is ever merged or moved). Every the app writes carries decoding=async (43 template sites), with a runtime backstop that reports anything a future template forgets. Gates: new qa/browser/t-v251-alive.mjs (46) — 46 + 34 + 36 + 37 suites green, check-handoff green. Instruments: Shivaa.v251.{report,pulses,pop,tick,progress,syncImages}().
